Deputy working security at South Carolina gun show fatally shoots customer who shot him

COLUMBIA, South Carolina (AP) — A deputy working security at a gun show in South Carolina fatally shot someone who fired on him Saturday, authorities said. The Lexington County deputy was taken into surgery and was in stable condition, the sheriff’s office said in a statement. The sheriff’s office did not release any additional information […]

Actual Article Body:
COLUMBIA, South Carolina (AP) — A deputy working security at a gun show in South Carolina fatally shot someone who fired on him Saturday, authorities said.

The Lexington County deputy was taken into surgery and was in stable condition, the sheriff’s office said in a statement.
